item: oo-on: a click, key press or submit runs an action only when a person made it, for EVERY action (A-024 stage 2); 4 removals now ask first
summary: GESTURE_ONLY (31 names, fail-open when a destructive name was forgotten) is replaced by TRUSTED_EVENTS: ev.isTrusted is required for click, keydown and submit for every name; input/change/toggle stay open as ruled (R443). The account of why a trusted click alone suffices moves to tests/trusted_click_table.py (26 rows, reasons: restartable job control, one-click curation), held both ways by test_oo_on_helper_allowlist.py and test_destructive_surfaces.py. removeAnnotation, removeAuthor, removeDraftItem, familyResetGroup now confirm (4 keys x12, native review queue); secureErase already did. Measured first: no data-on binding is dispatched synthetically by the app. Not done: the ooClickId/ooSetValue helpers (follow-on), a trusted click on injected markup, browser click-through.
